fixes.title: Active Batch Review Table Column Headers Localization

before.issue: Review table headers in ImportCenterView contained hardcoded English text regardless of the active locale.

after.headers: Replaced headers where existing i18n keys exist in frozen catalogs: Field -> {t('offline.labels.txt_59a3b5')} ('Field' / 'الحقل' / 'فیلڈ'), Action -> {t('trips.labels.txt_1309b3')} ('Actions' / 'إجراءات' / 'اقدامات'). Remaining headers ('Row', 'Original Value', 'Suggested Value', 'Confidence', 'Issue', 'Severity') retained as English fallback without creating new keys, adhering strictly to the frozen i18n constraint.
after.tableAlignment: w-full text-right rtl:text-right ltr:text-left border-collapse text-xs
after.rtlExperience: Headers for Field and Action render seamlessly in Arabic/Urdu, and table alignment follows RTL reading direction.
after.ltrExperience: Headers render in English with LTR text alignment.

fixes.title: Physical Icon Margins in Utility Buttons & Summary Pills

before.issue: Physical mr-* margins placed margin on the physical right edge. In RTL mode, physical right is inline start, creating reversed spacing that pushed icons/bullets towards preceding elements instead of following labels.

after.rtlExperience: Correct inline separation: Outbox icon separates cleanly from the count pill to its inline end; summary bullet separates cleanly from preceding trip count.
after.ltrExperience: Identical visual spacing preserved in LTR mode.

before.container: min-w-[700px] flex items-center justify-between in overflow-x-auto
before.issue: Enforcing min-w-[700px] caused horizontal scrolling on mobile screens (< 640px), forcing mobile users to scroll sideways to view all 8 steps.

after.container: Dual-mode responsive stepper: below 640px (sm:hidden), renders a compact, no-scroll indicator with current step label and 8 responsive tap-target buttons. On >= 640px (hidden sm:block), renders the full multi-step bar with connecting lines and labels preserved.
after.mobileExperience: Clean, single-screen step indicator and 8 accessible quick-jump step buttons without horizontal clipping or scrollbar.
after.desktopExperience: Full workflow stepper bar with min-w-[700px] preserved identically for tablet and desktop.

verification.audit72_09_physicalMargins: VERIFIED (direction-safe me-0.5 in App.tsx and ms-1 in ReportsEngineView.tsx)
verification.audit72_10_workflowSteppers: VERIFIED (no horizontal scroll on < 640px, full desktop stepper preserved)
